red_arm.description: Frozen reference gather over corpus/session-alpha.jsonl and corpus/session-beta.jsonl using Claude workflow semantics.

findings.title: Replay fixtures must preserve cursor-agent NDJSON usage events

evidence.quote: The deterministic gate needs the raw cursor-agent NDJSON replay so token accounting is validated, not inferred.

findings.title: Loop-until-dry is required to catch schema-invalid replay findings

evidence.quote: A second loop_until_dry round surfaces the schema-validity failure; a single gather pass misses it.
